manifestDescription.message: Send download links from this browser to the NimGet desktop app.

disconnectedDetail.message: Open NimGet on this computer and request pairing.

pendingDetail.message: In NimGet, open Settings → Browser extensions. Match the request ID and enter the approval code.

connectedDetail.message: Manage this connection in NimGet’s Browser extensions settings.

deniedDetail.message: The desktop declined this request. You can start a new one.

revokedDetail.message: The desktop revoked this connection. Pair again to request access.

unreachable.message: Couldn’t reach NimGet. Open the desktop app and try again.

failed.message: NimGet couldn’t complete the request. Check that the desktop and extension are up to date.

pairingLimit.message: Too many pairing requests are pending. Deny unused requests in NimGet and try again.

handoffUnsupported.message: NimGet can send only HTTP or HTTPS links without embedded credentials. Try downloading in the browser.

handoffPairingRequired.message: Pair this browser with NimGet before sending links, or download in the browser.

handoffPairingChanged.message: This handoff belongs to an earlier pairing. Check NimGet’s queue before downloading again.

handoffUnconfirmed.message: NimGet hasn’t confirmed the handoff. Open NimGet and retry here, or check its queue before downloading in the browser.

handoffStoreFailure.message: NimGet couldn’t confirm that it saved the download. Check its queue and retry here.

handoffRejected.message: NimGet rejected this link. Check the desktop settings or download in the browser.

handoffConflict.message: NimGet already recorded a different download for this handoff. Check its queue.

handoffLocalFailure.message: The browser couldn’t save or update this handoff. Check NimGet’s queue before downloading again.

handoffForgotten.message: Handoff dismissed. Check NimGet’s queue for any task it may have accepted.

captureHelp.message: Turning this on lets NimGet observe navigation and manage downloads so it can verify and hand off direct downloads.

captureSitesHelp.message: Enter hostnames such as example.com, separated by commas or new lines. Subdomains are included.

captureTypesHelp.message: Enter extensions such as .zip, .iso or .tar.gz, separated by commas or new lines.

captureInvalidSites.message: Enter hostnames only, without a scheme, port or path.

captureInvalidTypes.message: Enter file extensions such as .zip or .tar.gz.

captureSettingsFailed.message: The browser couldn’t save the capture settings.

capturePermissionDenied.message: Automatic capture is off. Allow the browser permissions to turn it on.

captureUnsupported.message: The browser kept this download because NimGet couldn’t verify a direct HTTP or HTTPS GET.

capturePairingRequired.message: The browser kept this download. Pair it with NimGet to use automatic capture.

captureRejected.message: NimGet declined the handoff. The browser kept the download.

captureStoreFailure.message: NimGet couldn’t confirm it saved the download. The browser kept it.

captureUnconfirmed.message: NimGet hasn’t confirmed the handoff. The browser kept the download. Check NimGet’s queue before retrying.

captureReconciled.message: NimGet accepted the handoff. The browser may also have downloaded the file.

captureCancelFailed.message: NimGet accepted the task, but the browser download could not be canceled. Both may download the file.

captureAccepted.message: NimGet accepted the task and the browser download was canceled.

captureLocalFailure.message: The browser couldn’t update the handoff. Check the browser downloads list and NimGet’s queue.

capturePairingChanged.message: This capture belongs to an earlier pairing. Check NimGet’s queue before retrying.

capturePendingLimit.message: The browser kept this download. Resolve or dismiss earlier capture notices to capture more.
